q: How do I request a consultation?
a: Use the consultation form on our contact page, call us, or send us a message on WhatsApp. Tell us briefly what your matter is about and how you would prefer to be contacted, and we will get back to you to arrange a time.

q: Do you act for individuals as well as businesses?
a: Yes. We act for individuals and families on personal matters, and for businesses of different sizes on their commercial and legal needs.

A retainer is an ongoing arrangement in which we act as your business's legal partner. We learn your business and give you direct, priority access to our team, with fixed, predictable fees agreed in advance.

q: What is the quickest way to reach you?
a: WhatsApp or a phone call is usually the quickest way to reach us. You can also use the consultation form, and we will respond as soon as we can.

q: What should I bring to a first consultation?
a: Bring any documents connected to your matter, such as agreements, letters, title documents or court papers, along with your identification and a short note of the key dates and questions you want to ask.

q: Will my enquiry be kept confidential?
a: We treat every enquiry with discretion. Even so, please do not include confidential or sensitive details in the website form. Submitting an enquiry does not by itself create an advocate–client relationship.
